evidence.source: ef1 2026-11-03 12:10, presented hair box, supplied live evidence

rr_hair_guide.hypothesis_target: A valid coverage-aware guide would bring hair residual and sparkle to the rr_post=0 level without changing mean brightness or grading.
rr_hair_guide.reason: The local SDK transparency overlay requires removed premultiplied radiance. A binary G-buffer class or bare alpha cannot be passed as that input. No invented reactive input is queued.

rr_hair_resolve.prediction: Coverage resolve lowers hair residual and sparkle toward the same-run post-late reference, while mean brightness, grading and rigid-control noise remain within baseline repeat spread.
rr_hair_resolve.reference_only: ef1 post-late residual 1.25 and sparkle 0.35%; these are targets, not claimed results.
rr_hair_resolve.limit: Class-5 occupancy is binary surviving coverage, not the original fragment alpha. An aligned cell resolve is experimental; it does not establish recovery of the game's exact dither pattern.

decision.registration: Per-window rigid registration excluding the subtitle region; y >= 590 at 1920x800 is excluded, scaled with extent. Reject cuts and invalid windows.
decision.improvement: Each candidate must beat both new baseline windows by more than their measured repeat spread; also report distance from the same-run post-late reference in residual and sparkle.
decision.reference_bands: Historical residual spread is 0.47; historical sparkle spread is 0.76 percentage points. Derive final bands from ef2 repeats, never tune them to the candidate.
decision.energy: Compare baseline A/B versus hair-resolve at two ungraded stages: Xr (RR colour: dither-resolved X) and Z (RR output before the grade). Resolve these tracker images through the trace rrpost-tagged pass: color slot 0 is Xr, slot 2 is Z (rrpost_trace_images order). Join their image references/pass ordinal to dumps.json and use full-resolution decoded float RGB mean, weighted luminance and nonfinite count. Normalize scene drift with pre-post compose pass 5c3fdabc. Require candidate Xr and Z mean ratios to agree with baseline within the measured baseline-repeat spread; zero nonfinite pixels. Preserving Sharp cell mean does not guarantee preserved geometric Xr energy under spatially varying DoF A/C. Compose alone cannot detect candidate darkening. Never infer energy from PNG/PQ/bloom. rr_post=0 is only a temporal reference: its graded input/output is not comparable to raw linear Xr/Z.
decision.grading: For baseline-versus-resolve, compare grade constants/LUT identity and float grade-output means after confirming Xr/Z energy. Use compose mean for scene normalization. PQ hair mean is supplementary only. Do not compare rr_post=0 raw output energy against linear pre-post output. Any unexplained grade change blocks a quality pass.
decision.cost: Read ngx guides/evaluate and rrpost chain/grade GPU ms only from separate timing windows. First straddling sample is discarded by expect_every. No build/compile/live contention allowed. Resolve is inside chain timing, but occupancy capture occurs before the existing evaluate timer: these logs do not establish total candidate GPU cost.
decision.quality: No live evidence yet. Lower residual with reduced energy or softened detail is not a pass. Review hair detail and rigid-control patch.
decision.activation: The hair-resolve timing window must emit [rrpost] hair resolve: current class-5 occupancy, WIDTHxHEIGHT, mixed 4x4 cells after 1 s settling. Missing activation is INVALID; a pipeline fallback cannot count as candidate evidence.
